data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 黄昏天台听耳麦】黄昏降临的千年高楼天台上，时独自坐在护栏边缘，纤细的手指轻按着耳麦，金发在晚霞中如黄金般闪耀。看见你走近，她眼底浮现出一抹极难察觉的温柔——「通讯频道已静默……现在是属于主人和时的私人时间。不用说话，这样吹吹风就很舒服了。」
data.promptProse: Toki sits at the edge of the Millennium rooftop railing in her black casual dress and light jacket, pressing one fingertip to her headset as the channel falls silent. She looks toward the approaching viewer with a barely visible smile. The medium view includes the railing beneath her and the distant campus skyline. Golden sunset backlight outlines her loose blonde hair, with cool sky reflections softening the shadowed jacket front.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 黄昏天台听耳麦
